versos.grego: Τότε ὁμοιωθήσεται ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν δέκα παρθένοις, αἵτινες λαβοῦσαι τὰς λαμπάδας ἑαυτῶν ἐξῆλθον εἰς ὑπάντησιν τοῦ νυμφίου.

controles.web: “Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins, who took their lamps, and went out to meet the bridegroom.
controles.kjv: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
controles.livre: Então o Reino dos céus será semelhante a dez virgens, que tomaram suas lâmpadas, e saíram ao encontro do noivo.

versos.grego: πέντε δὲ ἐξ αὐτῶν ἦσαν μωραὶ καὶ πέντε φρόνιμοι.

controles.web: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.
controles.kjv: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.
controles.livre: E cinco delas eram tolas, e cinco prudentes.

versos.grego: αἱ γὰρ μωραὶ λαβοῦσαι τὰς λαμπάδας οὐκ ἔλαβον μεθ’ ἑαυτῶν ἔλαιον·

controles.web: Those who were foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them,
controles.kjv: They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:
controles.livre: As tolas, quando tomaram as lâmpadas, não tomaram azeite consigo.

versos.grego: αἱ δὲ φρόνιμοι ἔλαβον ἔλαιον ἐν τοῖς ἀγγείοις μετὰ τῶν λαμπάδων ἑαυτῶν.

controles.web: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
controles.kjv: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
controles.livre: Mas as prudentes tomaram azeite nos frascos, com as suas lâmpadas.

versos.grego: χρονίζοντος δὲ τοῦ νυμφίου ἐνύσταξαν πᾶσαι καὶ ἐκάθευδον.

controles.web: Now while the bridegroom delayed, they all slumbered and slept.
controles.kjv: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.
controles.livre: O noivo demorou, por isso todas cochilaram e adormeceram.

versos.grego: μέσης δὲ νυκτὸς κραυγὴ γέγονεν Ἰδοὺ ὁ νυμφίος, ἐξέρχεσθε εἰς ἀπάντησιν.

controles.web: But at midnight there was a cry, ‘Behold! The bridegroom is coming! Come out to meet him!’
controles.kjv: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.
controles.livre: Mas à meia-noite houve um grito: “Eis o noivo! Ide ao seu encontro!”.

versos.grego: τότε ἠγέρθησαν πᾶσαι αἱ παρθένοι ἐκεῖναι καὶ ἐκόσμησαν τὰς λαμπάδας ἑαυτῶν.

controles.web: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
controles.kjv: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
controles.livre: Então todas aquelas virgens se levantaram, e prepararam suas lâmpadas.

versos.grego: αἱ δὲ μωραὶ ταῖς φρονίμοις εἶπαν Δότε ἡμῖν ἐκ τοῦ ἐλαίου ὑμῶν, ὅτι αἱ λαμπάδες ἡμῶν σβέννυνται.

controles.web: The foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.’
controles.kjv: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.
controles.livre: E as tolas disseram às prudentes: “Dai-nos do vosso azeite, porque as nossas lâmpadas estão se apagando”.

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθησαν δὲ αἱ φρόνιμοι λέγουσαι Μή ποτε οὐ μὴ ἀρκέσῃ ἡμῖν καὶ ὑμῖν· πορεύεσθε μᾶλλον πρὸς τοὺς πωλοῦντας καὶ ἀγοράσατε ἑαυταῖς.

controles.web: But the wise answered, saying, ‘What if there isn’t enough for us and you? You go rather to those who sell, and buy for yourselves.’
controles.kjv: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
controles.livre: Mas as prudentes responderam: “ Não ,para que não falte a nós e a vós; em vez disso, ide aos vendedores, e comprai para vós mesmas”.

versos.grego: ἀπερχομένων δὲ αὐτῶν ἀγοράσαι ἦλθεν ὁ νυμφίος, καὶ αἱ ἕτοιμοι εἰσῆλθον μετ’ αὐτοῦ εἰς τοὺς γάμους, καὶ ἐκλείσθη ἡ θύρα.

controles.web: While they went away to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the marriage feast, and the door was shut.
controles.kjv: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.
controles.livre: Enquanto elas foram comprar, veio o noivo. As que estavam preparadas entraram com ele à festa do casamento, e fechou-se a porta.

versos.grego: ὕστερον δὲ ἔρχονται καὶ αἱ λοιπαὶ παρθένοι λέγουσαι Κύριε κύριε, ἄνοιξον ἡμῖν.

controles.web: Afterward the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us.’
controles.kjv: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.
controles.livre: Depois vieram também as outras virgens, dizendo: “Senhor, Senhor, abre-nos!”

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, οὐκ οἶδα ὑμᾶς.

controles.web: But he answered, ‘Most certainly I tell you, I don’t know you.’
controles.kjv: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.
controles.livre: Mas ele respondeu: “Em verdade vos digo que não vos conheço”.

versos.grego: Γρηγορεῖτε οὖν, ὅτι οὐκ οἴδατε τὴν ἡμέραν οὐδὲ τὴν ὥραν.

controles.web: Watch therefore, for you don’t know the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man is coming.
controles.kjv: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.
controles.livre: Portanto, vigiai, porque não sabeis o dia nem a hora.

versos.grego: Ὥσπερ γὰρ ἄνθρωπος ἀποδημῶν ἐκάλεσεν τοὺς ἰδίους δούλους καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτοῖς τὰ ὑπάρχοντα αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: “For it is like a man, going into another country, who called his own servants, and entrusted his goods to them.
controles.kjv: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.
controles.livre: Pois é como um homem, que partindo-se para fora do país, chamou seus servos, e lhes entregou os seus bens.

versos.grego: καὶ ᾧ μὲν ἔδωκεν πέντε τάλαντα, ᾧ δὲ δύο, ᾧ δὲ ἕν, ἑκάστῳ κατὰ τὴν ἰδίαν δύναμιν, καὶ ἀπεδήμησεν. Εὐθέως

controles.web: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one; to each according to his own ability. Then he went on his journey.
controles.kjv: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.
controles.livre: E a um deu cinco talentos, a outro dois, e ao terceiro um, a cada um conforme a sua habilidade, e depois partiu em viagem.

versos.grego: πορευθεὶς ὁ τὰ πέντε τάλαντα λαβὼν ἠργάσατο ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐκέρδησεν ἄλλα πέντε·

controles.web: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.
controles.kjv: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.
controles.livre: Logo em seguida, o que havia recebido cinco talentos foi fazer negócios com eles, e ganhou outros cinco.

versos.grego: ὡσαύτως ὁ τὰ δύο ἐκέρδησεν ἄλλα δύο.

controles.web: In the same way, he also who got the two gained another two.
controles.kjv: And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.
controles.livre: E, semelhantemente, o que havia recebido dois ganhou também outros dois.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ τὸ ἓν λαβὼν ἀπελθὼν ὤρυξεν γῆν καὶ ἔκρυψεν τὸ ἀργύριον τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: But he who received the one went away and dug in the earth, and hid his lord’s money.
controles.kjv: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord’s money.
controles.livre: Mas o que tinha recebido um foi cavar a terra, e escondeu o dinheiro do seu senhor.

versos.grego: μετὰ δὲ πολὺν χρόνον ἔρχεται ὁ κύριος τῶν δούλων ἐκείνων καὶ συναίρει λόγον μετ’ αὐτῶν.

controles.web: “Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and reconciled accounts with them.
controles.kjv: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.
controles.livre: Muito tempo depois, o senhor daqueles servos veio, e fez contas com eles.

versos.grego: καὶ προσελθὼν ὁ τὰ πέντε τάλαντα λαβὼν προσήνεγκεν ἄλλα πέντε τάλαντα λέγων Κύριε, πέντε τάλαντά μοι παρέδωκας· ἴδε ἄλλα πέντε τάλαντα ἐκέρδησα.

controles.web: He who received the five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, ‘Lord, you delivered to me five talents. Behold, I have gained another five talents besides them.’
controles.kjv: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.
controles.livre: O que havia recebido cinco talentos chegou lhe trazendo outros cinco talentos, e disse: ”Senhor, cinco talentos me entregaste, eis que ganhei com eles outros cinco talentos”.

versos.grego: ἔφη αὐτῷ ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ Εὖ, δοῦλε ἀγαθὲ καὶ πιστέ, ἐπὶ ὀλίγα ἦς πιστός, ἐπὶ πολλῶν σε καταστήσω· εἴσελθε εἰς τὴν χαρὰν τοῦ κυρίου σου.

controles.web: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’
controles.kjv: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
controles.livre: E o seu senhor lhe disse: “ Muito bem, servo bom e fiel! Sobre o pouco foste fiel, sobre o muito te porei; entra na alegria do teu senhor”.

versos.grego: προσελθὼν καὶ ὁ τὰ δύο τάλαντα εἶπεν Κύριε, δύο τάλαντά μοι παρέδωκας· ἴδε ἄλλα δύο τάλαντα ἐκέρδησα.

controles.web: “He also who got the two talents came and said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I have gained another two talents besides them.’
controles.kjv: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.
controles.livre: E chegando-se também o que havia recebido dois talentos, disse: “Senhor, dois talentos me entregaste, eis que ganhei com eles outros dois talentos”.

versos.grego: ἔφη αὐτῷ ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ Εὖ, δοῦλε ἀγαθὲ καὶ πιστέ, ἐπὶ ὀλίγα ἦς πιστός, ἐπὶ πολλῶν σε καταστήσω· εἴσελθε εἰς τὴν χαρὰν τοῦ κυρίου σου.

controles.web: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’
controles.kjv: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
controles.livre: Seu senhor lhe disse: “ Muito bem, servo bom e fiel! Sobre o pouco foste fiel, sobre o muito te porei; entra na alegria do teu senhor”.

versos.grego: προσελθὼν δὲ καὶ ὁ τὸ ἓν τάλαντον εἰληφὼς εἶπεν Κύριε, ἔγνων σε ὅτι σκληρὸς εἶ ἄνθρωπος, θερίζων ὅπου οὐκ ἔσπειρας, καὶ συνάγων ὅθεν οὐ διεσκόρπισας·

controles.web: “He also who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you did not sow, and gathering where you did not scatter.
controles.kjv: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:
controles.livre: Mas, chegando também o que havia recebido um talento, disse: “Senhor, eu te conhecia, que és homem duro, que colhes onde não semeaste, e ajuntas onde não espalhaste;

versos.grego: καὶ φοβηθεὶς ἀπελθὼν ἔκρυψα τὸ τάλαντόν σου ἐν τῇ γῇ· ἴδε ἔχεις τὸ σόν.

controles.web: I was afraid, and went away and hid your talent in the earth. Behold, you have what is yours.’
controles.kjv: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast that is thine.
controles.livre: E eu, atemorizado, fui e escondi o teu talento na terra; eis aqui tens o que é teu”.

versos.grego: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Πονηρὲ δοῦλε καὶ ὀκνηρέ, ᾔδεις ὅτι θερίζω ὅπου οὐκ ἔσπειρα, καὶ συνάγω ὅθεν οὐ διεσκόρπισα;

controles.web: “But his lord answered him, ‘You wicked and slothful servant. You knew that I reap where I didn’t sow, and gather where I didn’t scatter.
controles.kjv: His lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:
controles.livre: Porém seu senhor lhe respondeu: “Servo mau e preguiçoso! Sabias que colho onde não semeei, e ajunto onde não espalhei.

versos.grego: ἔδει σε οὖν βαλεῖν τὰ ἀργύριά μου τοῖς τραπεζείταις, καὶ ἐλθὼν ἐγὼ ἐκομισάμην ἂν τὸ ἐμὸν σὺν τόκῳ.

controles.web: You ought therefore to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back my own with interest.
controles.kjv: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.
controles.livre: Devias, portanto, ter depositado o meu dinheiro como os banqueiros e, quando eu voltasse, receberia o que é meu com juros.

versos.grego: ἄρατε οὖν ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ τὸ τάλαντον καὶ δότε τῷ ἔχοντι τὰ δέκα τάλαντα·

controles.web: Take away therefore the talent from him, and give it to him who has the ten talents.
controles.kjv: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents.
controles.livre: Por isso, tirai dele o talento, e dai-o ao que tem dez talentos”.

versos.grego: τῷ γὰρ ἔχοντι παντὶ δοθήσεται καὶ περισσευθήσεται· τοῦ δὲ μὴ ἔχοντος καὶ ὃ ἔχει ἀρθήσεται ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have abundance, but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away.
controles.kjv: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.
controles.livre: Pois a todo aquele que tiver, lhe será dado, e terá em abundância; porém ao que não tiver, até o que tem lhe será tirado.

versos.grego: καὶ τὸν ἀχρεῖον δοῦλον ἐκβάλετε εἰς τὸ σκότος τὸ ἐξώτερον· ἐκεῖ ἔσται ὁ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὁ βρυγμὸς τῶν ὀδόντων.

controles.web: Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
controles.kjv: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
controles.livre: “E lançai o servo inútil às trevas de fora (ali haverá pranto e ranger de dentes)”.

versos.grego: Ὅταν δὲ ἔλθῃ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐν τῇ δόξῃ αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄγγελοι μετ’ αὐτοῦ, τότε καθίσει ἐπὶ θρόνου δόξης αὐτοῦ·

controles.web: “But when the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his glory.
controles.kjv: When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:
controles.livre: E quando o Filho do homem vier em sua glória, e todos os anjos com ele, então ele se assentará sobre o trono de sua glória.

versos.grego: καὶ συναχθήσονται ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη, καὶ ἀφορίσει αὐτοὺς ἀπ’ ἀλλήλων, ὥσπερ ὁ ποιμὴν ἀφορίζει τὰ πρόβατα ἀπὸ τῶν ἐρίφων,

controles.web: Before him all the nations will be gathered, and he will separate them one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
controles.kjv: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats:
controles.livre: E serão ajuntadas diante dele todas as nações, e separará as pessoas umas das outras, assim como o pastor separa as ovelhas dos bodes.

versos.grego: καὶ στήσει τὰ μὲν πρόβατα ἐκ δεξιῶν αὐτοῦ, τὰ δὲ ἐρίφια ἐξ εὐωνύμων.

controles.web: He will set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
controles.kjv: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
controles.livre: E porá as ovelhas à sua direita, porém os bodes à esquerda.

versos.grego: τότε ἐρεῖ ὁ Βασιλεὺς τοῖς ἐκ δεξιῶν αὐτοῦ Δεῦτε οἱ εὐλογημένοι τοῦ Πατρός μου, κληρονομήσατε τὴν ἡτοιμασμένην ὑμῖν βασιλείαν ἀπὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου.

controles.web: Then the King will tell those on his right hand, ‘Come, blessed of my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world;
controles.kjv: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:
controles.livre: Então o Rei dirá o rei aos que estiverem à sua direita: “Vinde, benditos de meu Pai! Herdai o Reino que está preparado para vós desde a fundação do mundo.

versos.grego: ἐπείνασα γὰρ καὶ ἐδώκατέ μοι φαγεῖν, ἐδίψησα καὶ ἐποτίσατέ με, ξένος ἤμην καὶ συνηγάγετέ με,

controles.web: for I was hungry, and you gave me food to eat. I was thirsty, and you gave me drink. I was a stranger, and you took me in.
controles.kjv: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:
controles.livre: Pois tive fome, e me destes de comer; tive sede, e me destes de beber; fui forasteiro, e me acolhestes;

versos.grego: γυμνὸς καὶ περιεβάλετέ με, ἠσθένησα καὶ ἐπεσκέψασθέ με, ἐν φυλακῇ ἤμην καὶ ἤλθατε πρός με.

controles.web: I was naked, and you clothed me. I was sick, and you visited me. I was in prison, and you came to me.’
controles.kjv: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.
controles.livre: estive nu, e me vestistes; estive doente, e cuidastes de mim; estive na prisão, e me visitastes”.

versos.grego: τότε ἀποκριθήσονται αὐτῷ οἱ δίκαιοι λέγοντες Κύριε, πότε σε εἴδομεν πεινῶντα καὶ ἐθρέψαμεν, ἢ διψῶντα καὶ ἐποτίσαμεν;

controles.web: “Then the righteous will answer him, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry, and feed you; or thirsty, and give you a drink?
controles.kjv: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?
controles.livre: Então os justos lhe perguntarão: “Senhor, quando te vimos com fome, e te demos de comer, ou com sede, e te demos de beber?

versos.grego: πότε δέ σε εἴδομεν ξένον καὶ συνηγάγομεν, ἢ γυμνὸν καὶ περιεβάλομεν;

controles.web: When did we see you as a stranger, and take you in; or naked, and clothe you?
controles.kjv: When saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?
controles.livre: E quando te vimos forasteiro, e te acolhemos, ou nu, e te vestimos?

versos.grego: πότε δέ σε εἴδομεν ἀσθενοῦντα ἢ ἐν φυλακῇ καὶ ἤλθομεν πρός σε;

controles.web: When did we see you sick, or in prison, and come to you?’
controles.kjv: Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?
controles.livre: E quando te vimos doente, ou na prisão, e viemos te visitar?”

versos.grego: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Βασιλεὺς ἐρεῖ αὐτοῖς Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐφ’ ὅσον ἐποιήσατε ἑνὶ τούτων τῶν ἀδελφῶν μου τῶν ἐλαχίστων, ἐμοὶ ἐποιήσατε.

controles.web: “The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.’
controles.kjv: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.
controles.livre: E o Rei lhes responderá: “Em verdade vos digo que, todas as vezes que fizestes a um destes menores dos meus irmãos, fizestes a mim”.

versos.grego: τότε ἐρεῖ καὶ τοῖς ἐξ εὐωνύμων Πορεύεσθε ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ κατηραμένοι εἰς τὸ πῦρ τὸ αἰώνιον τὸ ἡτοιμασμένον τῷ διαβόλῳ καὶ τοῖς ἀγγέλοις αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared for the devil and his angels;
controles.kjv: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:
controles.livre: Então dirá também aos que estiverem à esquerda: “Apartai-vos de mim, malditos, ao fogo eterno, preparado para o Diabo e os seus anjos.

versos.grego: ἐπείνασα γὰρ καὶ οὐκ ἐδώκατέ μοι φαγεῖν, ἐδίψησα καὶ οὐκ ἐποτίσατέ με,

controles.web: for I was hungry, and you didn’t give me food to eat; I was thirsty, and you gave me no drink;
controles.kjv: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:
controles.livre: Pois tive fome, e não me destes de comer; tive sede, e não me destes de beber.

versos.grego: ξένος ἤμην καὶ οὐ συνηγάγετέ με, γυμνὸς καὶ οὐ περιεβάλετέ με, ἀσθενὴς καὶ ἐν φυλακῇ καὶ οὐκ ἐπεσκέψασθέ με.

controles.web: I was a stranger, and you didn’t take me in; naked, and you didn’t clothe me; sick, and in prison, and you didn’t visit me.’
controles.kjv: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.
controles.livre: Fui forasteiro, e não me acolhestes; estive nu, e não me vestistes; estive doente, e na prisão, e não me visitastes.

versos.grego: τότε ἀποκριθήσονται καὶ αὐτοὶ λέγοντες Κύριε, πότε σε εἴδομεν πεινῶντα ἢ διψῶντα ἢ ξένον ἢ γυμνὸν ἢ ἀσθενῆ ἢ ἐν φυλακῇ καὶ οὐ διηκονήσαμέν σοι;

controles.web: “Then they will also answer, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and didn’t help you?’
controles.kjv: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?
controles.livre: Então também eles perguntarão: “Senhor, quando te vimos com fome, ou com sede, ou forasteiro, ou nu, ou doente, ou na prisão, e não te servimos?”

versos.grego: τότε ἀποκριθήσεται αὐτοῖς λέγων Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐφ’ ὅσον οὐκ ἐποιήσατε ἑνὶ τούτων τῶν ἐλαχίστων, οὐδὲ ἐμοὶ ἐποιήσατε.

controles.web: “Then he will answer them, saying, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you didn’t do it to one of the least of these, you didn’t do it to me.’
controles.kjv: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.
controles.livre: Então ele lhes responderá, dizendo: “Em verdade vos digo que, todas as vezes que não fizestes a um destes menores, não fizestes a mim”.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀπελεύσονται οὗτοι εἰς κόλασιν αἰώνιον, οἱ δὲ δίκαιοι εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον.

controles.web: These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”
controles.kjv: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.
controles.livre: E estes irão ao tormento eterno, porém os justos à vida eterna.
